system.description: The Solar heroes express their desires clearly. Language barriers do not stop them--their every gesture conveys their desired meaning. This Charm removes external penalties to dramatic actions and combat actions caused by the character not knowing others' languages. She can convey tactical and strategic necessities with expressive gestures and sounds. For example, she can easily convey "Duck!" or work with backwater natives to develop their agriculture. This Charm does not remove penalties to social or military actions, so the character will have a difficult time persuading or leading others--naturally or unnaturally--if she does not know their language.
